accepted.title: Optimal energy attained by polynomial-time spin-glass algorithms
accepted.text: Fix P and γ₁,…,γ_P≥0. For independent standard Gaussian coefficients g^{(p)}_{i₁,…,i_p}, set H_N(σ)=Σ_{p=1}^P γ_p N^{−(p−1)/2}Σ_{i₁,…,i_p=1}^N g^{(p)}_{i₁,…,i_p}σ_{i₁}⋯σ_{i_p}. Separately for Σ_N={±1}^N and S_N={σ∈ℝ^N:‖σ‖²=N}, determine the supremal E such that a polynomial-time randomized algorithm A, given the disorder coefficients defining H_N, outputs σ_alg in the chosen domain with P(H_N(σ_alg)/N≥E−ε)→1 for every fixed ε>0 as N→∞.
accepted.subject: Probability & Spin Glasses

locator.verified_from: Actual physicalPDF page and printed footer

accepted.scope_review: Full polynomial-time algorithm class; not just Lipschitz/stable algorithms. Fixed finite mixture, and probability includes disorder and algorithm randomness. Energy is normalized byN as in equation1.5.
accepted.literature_finding: Primary2303.12172 characterizes maximum energy for suitably Lipschitz algorithms, while2308.09672 provides matching efficient algorithms. Current author2026 works do not claim optimality among every polynomial-time algorithm; no unrestricted threshold closure located.
accepted.status_grade: B: explicit primary question, fresh bounded status assessment
accepted.duplicate_review: Whole numbered Hamiltonian/spin-glass/Gibbs-sampling and corpus family comparison: existingQ48 is only annealing under the non-shattering criterion. It does not characterize all polynomial algorithms or all feasible inverse temperatures. SavedBhatia questions concern random geometry, not spin glasses.

accepted.title: Temperatures permitting efficient total-variation sampling of spherical spin glasses
accepted.text: Fix P and γ₁,…,γ_P≥0. For independent standard Gaussian coefficients g^{(p)}_{i₁,…,i_p}, set H_N(σ)=Σ_{p=1}^P γ_p N^{−(p−1)/2}Σ_{i₁,…,i_p=1}^N g^{(p)}_{i₁,…,i_p}σ_{i₁}⋯σ_{i_p}. Let m_N be uniform probability on S_N={‖σ‖²=N}, and let μ_{N,β}(dσ)=Z_{N,β}^{−1}exp(βH_N(σ))m_N(dσ), with fixed β≥0. For which β does there exist a polynomial-time randomized algorithm, given H_N and β, whose conditional output law ν_{N,β} satisfies TV(ν_{N,β},μ_{N,β})→0 in probability over the Gaussian disorder as N→∞?
accepted.subject: Probability & Spin Glasses

locator.verified_from: Actual physicalPDF page and printed footer

accepted.scope_review: Conditional output law for a given Hamiltonian, not an annealed average which could simply be uniform. Fixed mixture andβ. Strong total-variation requirement; not Wasserstein-only sampling or mixing from every initial point.
accepted.literature_finding: Primary2404.15651 gives total-variation sampling under ξ″(s)<(1−s)⁻², while2411.09075 gives simulated annealing to that threshold. They leave a gap to the shattering prediction.2026 high-temperature Ising parallel-sampling theorem is a different domain and restricted regime. No complete spherical-temperature characterization located.
